in_sanskrit.name: निमिषा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who contemplates or observes, the one who has mindfulness and attentiveness.

in_hindi.name: निमिषा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Someone who is deep in thought, someone who enters deeply into something.

in_tamil.name: நிமிஷா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Someone who stands firm, someone who has the ability to pierce or penetrate, someone who is sharp and incisive.

in_telugu.name: నిమిష
in_telugu.long_meaning: Someone who is eager and impatient, someone who is the lord of the senses.

in_marathi.name: Nimisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Impression, mark, sign
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nimisha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Nimisha’, which means 'impression', 'mark', or 'sign'. In Hindu mythology, Nimisha is the goddess of time and is often depicted as the wife of Lord Mahadev. She is believed to hold the cosmic time in her hands and is known for her compassionate nature.
